answer: Sybil resistance can come from a staking-and-audit kernel: each agent must lock a bond and pass randomized peer audits, where a small yarrow-marked sample of its work is re-executed by independent validators. Honest agents recover their stake; fakes lose the full bond, so mass-registering identities costs more than any reward a tide of duplicate accounts could extract.
